verses.original: דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֣ה׀ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֗ה אֶל־ מִיכָה֙ הַמֹּ֣רַשְׁתִּ֔י בִּימֵ֥י יוֹתָ֛ם אָחָ֥ז יְחִזְקִיָּ֖ה מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר־ חָזָ֥ה עַל־ שֹׁמְר֖וֹן וִירֽוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: də·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ă·šer hā·yāh ’el- mî·ḵāh ham·mō·raš·tî bî·mê yō·w·ṯām ’ā·ḥāz yə·ḥiz·qî·yāh mal·ḵê yə·hū·ḏāh ’ă·šer- ḥā·zāh ‘al- šō·mə·rō·wn wî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: [This is] the word of the LORD that came to Micah the Moreshite in the days of Jotham Ahaz and Hezekiah kings of Judah what he saw regarding Samaria and Jerusalem

verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ֙ עַמִּ֣ים כֻּלָּ֔ם הַקְשִׁ֖יבִי אֶ֣רֶץ וּמְלֹאָ֑הּ אֲדֹנָ֨י יְהוִ֤ה וִיהִי֩ לְעֵ֔ד בָּכֶם֙ אֲדֹנָ֖י קָדְשֽׁוֹ׃ מֵהֵיכַ֥ל
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū ‘am·mîm kul·lām haq·šî·ḇî ’e·reṣ ū·mə·lō·’āh ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh wî·hî lə·‘êḏ bā·ḵem ’ă·ḏō·nāy qā·ḏə·šōw mê·hê·ḵal
verses.literal: Hear O peoples all of you listen O earth and everyone in it May the Lord GOD bear witness against you the Lord from His holy temple

verses.original: כִּֽי־ הִנֵּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה יֹצֵ֣א מִמְּקוֹמ֑וֹ וְיָרַ֥ד וְדָרַ֖ךְ עַל־ בָּמוֹתֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- hin·nêh Yah·weh yō·ṣê mim·mə·qō·w·mōw wə·yā·raḏ wə·ḏā·raḵ ‘al- bå̄·mō·ṯē ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: For behold the LORD comes forth from His dwelling place He will come down and tread on the high places of the earth

verses.original: הֶֽהָרִים֙ וְנָמַ֤סּוּ תַּחְתָּ֔יו וְהָעֲמָקִ֖ים יִתְבַּקָּ֑עוּ כַּדּוֹנַג֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י הָאֵ֔שׁ כְּמַ֖יִם מֻגָּרִ֥ים בְּמוֹרָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: he·hā·rîm wə·nā·mas·sū taḥ·tāw wə·hā·‘ă·mā·qîm yiṯ·baq·qā·‘ū kad·dō·w·naḡ mip·pə·nê hā·’êš kə·ma·yim mug·gā·rîm bə·mō·w·rāḏ
verses.literal: The mountains will melt beneath Him and the valleys will split apart like wax before the fire like water rushing down a slope

verses.original: כָּל־ זֹ֔את בְּפֶ֤שַׁע יַֽעֲקֹב֙ וּבְחַטֹּ֖אות בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִֽי־ פֶ֣שַׁע יַעֲקֹ֗ב הֲלוֹא֙ שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן וּמִי֙ בָּמ֣וֹת יְהוּדָ֔ה הֲל֖וֹא יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- zōṯ bə·p̄e·ša‘ ya·‘ă·qōḇ ū·ḇə·ḥaṭ·ṭō·wṯ bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl mî- p̄e·ša‘ ya·‘ă·qōḇ hă·lō·w šō·mə·rō·wn ū·mî bā·mō·wṯ yə·hū·ḏāh hă·lō·w yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: All this [is] for the transgression of Jacob and the sins of the house of Israel What [is] the transgression of Jacob Is it not Samaria And what is the high place of Judah Is it not Jerusalem

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֥י שֹׁמְר֛וֹן לְעִ֥י הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה לְמַטָּ֣עֵי כָ֑רֶם וְהִגַּרְתִּ֤י אֲבָנֶ֔יהָ לַגַּי֙ אֲגַלֶּֽה׃ וִיסֹדֶ֖יהָ
verses.transliteration: wə·śam·tî šō·mə·rō·wn lə·‘î haś·śā·ḏeh lə·maṭ·ṭā·‘ê ḵā·rem wə·hig·gar·tî ’ă·ḇā·ne·hā lag·gay ’ă·ḡal·leh wî·sō·ḏe·hā
verses.literal: Therefore I will make Samaria a heap of rubble in the open field a planting area for a vineyard I will pour her stones into the valley and expose her foundations

verses.original: וְכָל־ פְּסִילֶ֣יהָ יֻכַּ֗תּוּ וְכָל־ אֶתְנַנֶּ֙יהָ֙ יִשָּׂרְפ֣וּ בָאֵ֔שׁ אָשִׂ֣ים שְׁמָמָ֑ה וְכָל־ עֲצַבֶּ֖יהָ כִּ֠י קִבָּ֔צָה וְעַד־ מֵאֶתְנַ֤ן זוֹנָה֙ אֶתְנַ֥ן יָשֽׁוּבוּ׃ זוֹנָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵāl pə·sî·le·hā yuk·kat·tū wə·ḵāl ’eṯ·nan·ne·hā yiś·śā·rə·p̄ū ḇā·’êš ’ā·śîm šə·mā·māh wə·ḵāl ‘ă·ṣab·be·hā kî qib·bā·ṣāh wə·‘aḏ- mê·’eṯ·nan zō·w·nāh ’eṯ·nan yā·šū·ḇū zō·w·nāh
verses.literal: All her carved images will be smashed to pieces all her wages will be burned in the fire and I will destroy . . . all her idols Since she collected . . . the wages of a prostitute they will be used again on a prostitute

verses.original: עַל־ זֹאת֙ אֶסְפְּדָ֣ה וְאֵילִ֔ילָה אֵילְכָ֥ה שֵׁילָל וְעָר֑וֹם אֶעֱשֶׂ֤ה מִסְפֵּד֙ כַּתַּנִּ֔ים וְאֵ֖בֶל כִּבְנ֥וֹת יַעֲנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- zōṯ ’es·pə·ḏāh wə·’ê·lî·lāh ’ê·lə·ḵāh šē·lå̄l wə·‘ā·rō·wm ’e·‘ĕ·śeh mis·pêḏ kat·tan·nîm wə·’ê·ḇel kiḇ·nō·wṯ ya·‘ă·nāh
verses.literal: Because of this I will lament and wail I will walk barefoot and naked I will howl . . . like a jackal and mourn like an ostrich

verses.original: כִּ֥י מַכּוֹתֶ֑יהָ אֲנוּשָׁ֖ה כִּי־ בָ֙אָה֙ עַד־ יְהוּדָ֔ה נָגַ֛ע שַׁ֥עַר עַמִּ֖י עַד־ עַד־ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî mak·kō·w·ṯe·hā ’ă·nū·šāh kî- ḇā·’āh ‘aḏ- yə·hū·ḏāh nā·ḡa‘ ša·‘ar ‘am·mî ‘aḏ- ‘aḏ- yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: For her wound is incurable - it has reached . . . even Judah it has approached the gate of my people . . . as far as Jerusalem itself

verses.original: אַל־ תַּגִּ֔ידוּ בְּגַת֙ בָּכ֖וֹ אַל־ תִּבְכּ֑וּ הִתְפַּלָּשְׁתִּי׃ עָפָ֖ר בְּבֵ֣ית לְעַפְרָ֔ה
verses.transliteration: ’al- tag·gî·ḏū bə·ḡaṯ bā·ḵōw ’al- tiḇ·kū hiṯ·pal·lå̄·šə·tī ‘ā·p̄ār bə·ḇêṯ lə·‘ap̄·rāh
verses.literal: Do not tell it in Gath do not weep . . . at all Roll in the dust in Beth-leaphrah

verses.original: עִבְרִ֥י לָכֶ֛ם בֹ֑שֶׁת עֶרְיָה־ יוֹשֶׁ֥בֶת שָׁפִ֖יר יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת צַֽאֲנָ֔ן לֹ֤א יָֽצְאָה֙ בֵּ֣ית הָאֵ֔צֶל מִסְפַּד֙ עֶמְדָּתֽוֹ׃ יִקַּ֥ח מִכֶּ֖ם
verses.transliteration: ‘iḇ·rî lā·ḵem ḇō·šeṯ ‘er·yāh- yō·wō·še·ḇeṯ šā·p̄îr yō·wō·še·ḇeṯ ṣa·’ă·nān lō yā·ṣə·’āh bêṯ hā·’ê·ṣel mis·paḏ ‘em·dā·ṯōw yiq·qaḥ mik·kem
verses.literal: Depart in shameful nakedness O dwellers of Shaphir The dwellers of Zaanan will not come out vvv Beth-ezel is in mourning its support is taken from you

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת מָר֑וֹת חָ֥לָֽה לְט֖וֹב כִּֽי־ רָע֙ יָ֤רַד מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה לְשַׁ֖עַר יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yō·wō·še·ḇeṯ mā·rō·wṯ ḥā·lāh lə·ṭō·wḇ kî- rā‘ yā·raḏ mê·’êṯ Yah·weh lə·ša·‘ar yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: For the dwellers of Maroth pined for good but calamity came down from the LORD even to the gate of Jerusalem

verses.original: רְתֹ֧ם הַמֶּרְכָּבָ֛ה לָרֶ֖כֶשׁ יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת לָכִ֑ישׁ הִיא֙ רֵאשִׁ֨ית חַטָּ֥את לְבַת־ צִיּ֔וֹן כִּי־ פִּשְׁעֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ נִמְצְא֖וּ בָ֥ךְ
verses.transliteration: rə·ṯōm ham·mer·kā·ḇāh lā·re·ḵeš yō·wō·še·ḇeṯ lā·ḵîš hî rê·šîṯ ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ lə·ḇaṯ- ṣî·yō·wn kî- piš·‘ê yiś·rā·’êl nim·ṣə·’ū ḇāḵ
verses.literal: Harness your chariot horses O dweller of Lachish You were the beginning of sin to the Daughter of Zion for the transgressions of Israel were found in you

verses.original: לָכֵן֙ תִּתְּנִ֣י שִׁלּוּחִ֔ים עַ֖ל מוֹרֶ֣שֶׁת גַּ֑ת בָּתֵּ֤י אַכְזִיב֙ לְאַכְזָ֔ב לְמַלְכֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên tit·tə·nî šil·lū·ḥîm ‘al mō·w·re·šeṯ gaṯ bāt·tê ’aḵ·zîḇ lə·’aḵ·zāḇ lə·mal·ḵê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Therefore send farewell gifts to vvv Moresheth-gath the houses of Achzib [will] prove deceptive to the kings of Israel

verses.original: עֹ֗ד אָ֣בִי הַיֹּרֵשׁ֙ לָ֔ךְ יוֹשֶׁ֖בֶת מָֽרֵשָׁ֑ה כְּב֥וֹד יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ יָב֖וֹא עַד־ עֲדֻּלָּ֥ם
verses.transliteration: ‘ōḏ ’ā·ḇî hay·yō·rêš lāḵ yō·wō·še·ḇeṯ mā·rê·šāh kə·ḇō·wḏ yiś·rā·’êl yā·ḇō·w ‘aḏ- ʿăd·dul·lå̄m
verses.literal: I will again bring a conqueror against you O dweller of Mareshah The glory of Israel will come to Adullam

verses.original: קָרְחִ֣י וָגֹ֔זִּי עַל־ תַּעֲנוּגָ֑יִךְ בְּנֵ֖י הַרְחִ֤בִי קָרְחָתֵךְ֙ כַּנֶּ֔שֶׁר כִּ֥י מִמֵּֽךְ׃ס גָל֖וּ
verses.transliteration: qā·rə·ḥî wā·ḡōz·zî ‘al- ta·‘ă·nū·ḡā·yiḵ bə·nê har·ḥi·ḇî qā·rə·ḥā·ṯêḵ kan·ne·šer kî mim·mêḵ ḡā·lū
verses.literal: Shave yourselves bald and cut off your hair in mourning for your precious children make yourselves as bald as an eagle for they will go from you into exile
